item.title: Nurse shot in Hela, Church condemns attack on Health Worker
item.description: A nursing officer serving in a remote health facility in Hela Province is recovering from gunshot injuries after being shot outside her workplace on Tuesday evening, prompting strong condemnation from the Catholic Church Health Services Papua New Guinea. Nursing Officer Maggie Asue, the Officer-in-Charge of St Conrad Pureni Health Centre in the Koroba–Lake Kopiago District, was shot at around 7pm while returning to the facility after completing her duties.
